lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: Hello,

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: are you the Commander that's been in the spotlight lately?
I wouldn't go that far.

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: Perfect!

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: You don't even realize the extent of your own fame.

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: I'm a writer.

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: I wrote The Essence of Romance three years ago.

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: It was quite popular. It was even adapted into a webcomic, cartoon, and TV series.
Impressive.
Oh! I read that before!

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: Thank you for the compliment

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: So you're familiar with my work?

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: I'm very flattered!

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: Unfortunately, I'm in a bit of a creative slump right now.

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: However, I do have one idea.

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: Forbidden love between a Commander and his Nikke!!

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: I've been searching high and low for real-life inspiration,

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: and I think you're the best fit. Will you do it?
Do what, exactly?

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: Let me use you as a reference for my writing.

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: Could you record your daily routine and send it in to me?
How much detail do you want?

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: Don't worry, nothing overly private.

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: I just need information about hot, dangerous, and sensational situations you've gotten into with Nikkes!
I can do that.

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: I knew I could count on you!

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: I look forward to seeing

lines.speaker: writer
lines.text: what you come up with.
